facts.heading: Divorce after fifteen years of marriage
facts.content: Jana and her husband Radko decided on a divorce after fifteen years of marriage.
facts.evidence: After fifteen years of marriage, my husband Radko and I decided on a divorce.

facts.heading: Divorce conversation in September
facts.content: Radko told Jana in September that the marriage couldn't go on like this.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it couldn't go on like this.

facts.heading: Jana's emotional state during news
facts.content: Jana experienced feelings of emptiness and anger alternating several times a day.
facts.evidence: Emptiness. And then anger. Then emptiness again.

facts.heading: Radko's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radko stated that the couple drifted apart and lived next to each other.
facts.evidence: He says that we drifted apart. That we live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana's self-blame regarding marriage
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the drifting apart and looks for where she made a mistake.
facts.evidence: I keep going over it in my head and looking for where I made a mistake.

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about cause
facts.content: Jana sometimes thinks she was too tired and didn't care about Radko, other times she cared too much.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired and didn't care about him, other times that I cared too much.

facts.heading: Jana's suffering related to children
facts.content: Jana is suffering mainly because of the children.
facts.evidence: Yes. And mainly because of the children.

facts.heading: Jana's children's ages
facts.content: Jana has two children: Anička is twelve and Matěj is eight years old.
facts.evidence: Anička is twelve and Matěj is eight years old.

facts.heading: Plan to tell children about divorce
facts.content: Jana and Radko plan to tell the children about the divorce together.
facts.evidence: Radek wants us to tell them together, but we keep putting it off.

facts.heading: Anička suspects divorce
facts.content: Anička has already suspected something about the marriage.
facts.evidence: Anička already suspects something.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička when she asked if Dad and she were fighting.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if Dad and I are fighting. I said no.

facts.heading: Jana's fear regarding telling children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of her children's tears when telling them the truth.
facts.evidence: But I'm afraid of her tears.

facts.heading: Housing arrangements post-divorce
facts.content: The apartment is on a mortgage, and Radko is probably moving in with his brother.
facts.evidence: The apartment is on a mortgage. Radek is probably moving in with his brother, at least for now.

facts.heading: Children staying with Jana
facts.content: The children will stay with Jana after the divorce.
facts.evidence: The children will stay with me.

facts.heading: Jana's feeling of inability to cope
facts.content: Jana feels she cannot handle the situation alone because Radko always dealt with money.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I can't handle it alone. Radek always dealt with money.

facts.heading: Jana's occupation and students
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at an elementary school in Brno. She teaches nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at an elementary school in Brno. I teach nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.

facts.heading: Jana's feelings at school
facts.content: Jana feels a lump in her throat when going to class. She feels everyone sees her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I go to class with a lump in my throat. I have the feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Principal knows about Jana's issues
facts.content: Only the principal at the school knows about Jana's issues.
facts.evidence: Only the principal. I told her because I once cried in the hallway.

facts.heading: Principal allowed early departure
facts.content: The principal allowed Jana to leave early, giving her an hour off.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave early. She gave me an hour off.

facts.heading: Jana feels worse when alone
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at home compared to being at work.
facts.evidence: But then I sat at home and it was worse. Because I was alone with my head.

facts.heading: Sleep pattern and worries
facts.content: Jana wakes up at three in the morning every night worrying about the future.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at three in the morning and think about what will happen next.

facts.heading: Jana's self-assessment
facts.content: Jana feels she has nothing, stating she does not have a mortgage or a husband.
facts.evidence: That I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I have nothing.

facts.heading: Jana's eating and weight loss
facts.content: Jana eats little and has lost four kilos.
facts.evidence: I eat little. I lost four kilos.

facts.heading: Jana's support system
facts.content: Jana has her sister Alena in Olomouc, who calls her almost every evening. She also has a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have my sister Alena in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening. And a friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of failure
facts.content: Jana fears that she has failed and that a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I have failed. That a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Belief about marriage from mother
facts.content: Jana's mother always said that marriage lasts no matter what.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage lasts no matter what.

facts.heading: Mother's recent silence
facts.content: Jana's mother has not spoken much since the conversation about marriage.
facts.evidence: She hasn't spoken much since then.

facts.heading: Jana's current mood and needs
facts.content: Jana feels sad and wishes her mother would hug her.
facts.evidence: Sad. I would like her to hug me.

facts.heading: Jana's difficulty expressing feelings
facts.content: Jana feels that expressing her feelings is not done in her family.
facts.evidence: But that's not done in our family.

facts.heading: Jana's immediate needs
facts.content: Jana needs help with sleep and knowing how to tell her children.
facts.evidence: Sleep. And knowing how to tell the children.

facts.heading: Uses chamomile tea for sleep
facts.content: Jana uses chamomile tea for sleep.
facts.evidence: Chamomile tea, and that's it.

facts.heading: Refuses doctor's medication
facts.content: Jana does not want to take the pills the doctor offered.
facts.evidence: The doctor offered me pills, but I don't want to.

facts.heading: Fear of missing children's wake-up
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up in time for the children.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up in time for the children.

facts.heading: Desire not to be dependent
facts.content: Jana does not want to be dependent on others.
facts.evidence: And I don't want to be dependent.

facts.heading: Agrees to note wake-up triggers
facts.content: Jana agreed to try writing down what wakes her up.
facts.evidence: I could. At least I get it out of my head.

facts.heading: Fear of panicking around children
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will panic and cry around the children.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry.

facts.heading: Fear of crying in front of children
facts.content: Jana fears crying in front of the children because it would be terrifying for them.
facts.evidence: That I would cry in front of the children? It would be terrifying for them.

facts.heading: Anička is sensitive
facts.content: Jana believes Anička is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Anička is sensitive, maybe it would help her.

facts.heading: Feels not alone in struggle
facts.content: Jana feels that she is not alone and does not have to manage her issues right away.
facts.evidence: That I am not alone and that I don't have to manage it right away.
